meta.title: Smiljan — Coffee With Real Character
meta.description: Smiljan is a coffee shop with genuine character. Selected beans roasted in house, brewed by hand one cup at a time, in a room that is warm and full of colour.

hero.description: Selected beans we roast ourselves every week, then brew by hand one cup at a time. Not a coffee-themed space — a place to drink coffee slowly.

signature.title: Four cups we are proudest of
signature.description: Every cup exists for a reason. These are the ones people order most, and the ones we keep adjusting.

story.title: A place to drink coffee without hurrying
story.body: Smiljan began as a deliberate kind of simplicity: one bean, one process, one cup. We buy from growers we know, roast in small batches, and brew by hand in front of you. Nothing is done halfway, and nothing is done in a rush.
story.bodySecond: The room is deliberately warm and colourful. We want people to come and hang out, work, or simply sit and read without anyone pressuring them to leave.

why.title: Three things we do not compromise on

beans.title: Chosen beans, roasted in house
beans.body: We buy in small lots from growers we know, then roast weekly so every cup tastes freshly roasted.

manual.title: Brewed by hand, one cup at a time
manual.body: No machine brewing behind the counter. Every cup has its own reason for being made that way.

space.title: A room you can actually stay in
space.body: Outlets at every table, wifi that holds, and no rules about interrupting whoever is working.

gallery.title: The Smiljan atmosphere
gallery.description: The corners that make people stay longer than they planned to.

location.title: Come, sit, and stay awhile
location.description: We are open seven days a week. Just turn up, or book ahead if you are bringing a group.
